# Menu foundation

Menu infrastructure from DBF-MCM supports the automatic in-game frontend. `menu.lua` changes its window heading to EPIC LUT and exposes a configurable/disableable physical toggle key so the shared binding adapter is the sole own-menu hotkey handler. This is shared menu infrastructure, not a second editor implementation or a running MCM dependency. The generated bundle records each source hash. Float/native LUT discovery remains CowboyBingus's separately licensed work in the parent vendor directory.

Synchronize this snapshot deliberately after relevant maintained MCM changes, and rerun frontend lifecycle, grouping, focus, resize and restoration contracts. Do not choose replacements by timestamps or copy historical recovery candidates.
